subject: Request for isolated POC credits to validate VPC/security controls
messages:
From: Tom Espinoza <tom@medlyhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medlyhealth.com, procurement@medlyhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC support: isolated credit for VPC security evaluation

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the runtime and the private deployment options look promising. We're trying to move a small POC through our security review (risk team asked for a live validation inside an isolated VPC with HSM-backed keys and audit log retention).

Two asks from our side: 1) can Redwood provide a small pool of free credits scoped to a private/VPC POC (roughly 150k tokens + 2 GPU days) that will let us run a 2-week functional + security exercise? 2) can you share a short evidence pack (SOC2 summary + network diagram + list of KMS integrations) so our InfoSec can sign off quickly?

If you can sponsor the credits we can commit to a short exec review once controls are validated and discuss a Dedicated slot if results are positive. Looking to kick off the week of Aug 4.

Appreciate any fast-track path here — procurement is ready to accept a credit memo.

Best,
Tom
Tom Espinoza
Director of Engineering, Medly Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC support: isolated credit for VPC security evaluation

Hi Tom — great to hear. We can absolutely support an isolated VPC POC and provide a targeted credit allocation for the security validation.

Quick plan:
- I can authorize a 175k-token credit bundle + 2 dedicated GPU-days on a private tenant for a 21-day window.
- Dev will prepare the evidence pack: SOC2 extract, a simplified VPC/dataflow PNG that shows HSM/KMS, and our audit-log retention SLA.
- Marissa will draft a short credit memo for procurement to sign (DocuSign-ready).

Please confirm the desired kick-off range (you mentioned week of Aug 4) and the expected account owner we should route the DocuSign to. Once you confirm I’ll route the credit approval internally and share the evidence pack in 48 hours.

Rachel Kim
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0199
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC support: isolated credit for VPC security evaluation

Rachel / Marissa — I’ll assemble the evidence pack today. Draft items I’ll attach: SOC2-summary.pdf (one-pager), redwood-vpc-dataflow.png (annotated), list-of-kms-integrations.txt, and a short note about our audit log TTLs and retention policies.

Operational notes for the POC:
- We will provision a private tenant in us-west-2 with an isolation VLAN and explicit egress rules.
- HSM integration: we support AWS KMS + customer-managed keys in the VPC.
- Logging: request/response traces for the evaluation will be stored for 90 days in a read-only bucket; we can provide evidence exports for your auditors.

I recommend we limit the GPU reservation to 48 hours of contiguous dedicated time and the rest on preemptible burst — keeps costs lower but still validates performance.

I’ll push the artifacts to a secure share and flag Rachel once ready.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Espinoza <tom@medlyhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medlyhealth.com, procurement@medlyhealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC support: isolated credit for VPC security evaluation

Rachel / Dev — this is great, thanks. Confirming: week of Aug 4 works. Please send the DocuSign to purchase@medlyhealth.com.

Security asked three quick clarifications (they want answers in-line so they can close the risk ticket):
1) Will any production model weights or artifacts leave the VPC during the POC?
2) Who will have access to the KMS key material (Redwood ops vs our key admins)?
3) Will request logs include prompt contents by default?

If you can answer those 3 points in the evidence pack that should be enough to unblock us.

Tom
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Espinoza <tom@medlyhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC support: isolated credit for VPC security evaluation

Tom — answers below so your InfoSec ticket can close quickly. I’m also attaching the three artifacts (SOC2-summary.pdf, redwood-vpc-dataflow.png, credit-approval-memo.txt) and will push the same to a secure link.

1) Model/artifact residency: No model weights are exported out of the provisioned VPC for the duration of the POC. All inference happens inside the tenant; we do not persist customer model artifacts in our multi-tenant hosted pools.

2) KMS access: Keys can be customer-managed (we can support a bring-your-own key model). If you provide a customer-managed KMS in your account, only your key administrators will control rotation and key material; Redwood only receives cryptographic references and performs encryption operations via the KMS API. If you prefer Redwood-hosted keys, we can scope a restricted operator role but keys remain inaccessible to broad ops personnel.

3) Request logging: By default request logs will include request/response metadata but prompt contents are redacted unless you explicitly enable full-text logs. For the POC we suggest enabling redacted logs and short window exports (90 days) — we’ll include a snippet showing the redaction behavior.

Next steps: I’m authorizing a temporary credit bundle (175k tokens + 2 GPU-days) scoped to deal MH-POC-8421. Marissa — can you route the credit memo to purchase@medlyhealth.com and add the DocuSign link?

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Rachel Kim
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (1.1MB, summary), redwood-vpc-dataflow.png (210KB), credit-approval-memo.txt
